headline: Microsoft says China-aligned hackers used AI agents in ConnectWise breach
summary: Microsoft said a breach at ConnectWise let a China-aligned hacking group, identified as Storm-0940, loose on about 2,250 cloud tenants. The attackers used an AI agent framework called ARTEX to rapidly compromise thousands of customers, in some environments gaining privileged access in under three hours.
